note: Captain of the Guard: commands a squad of Guards of the Citadel (summons), orders (Shield Wall, Horn), the Swan Knights' charge, the beacons and the Eagles. Icons sliced from the aragorn, eowyn and Gimli-Legolas-Gandalf sheets (hacks/patches/heroes/guardofgondor_icons).

passives.name: Guard of the Citadel
passives.text: Plate of the Tower Guard: +2 melee and +2 missile armor per level.

passives.name: Swordsman of Gondor
passives.text: +1 Strength and +2% critical chance per level.

passives.name: Shield of the White Tree
passives.text: +3% block and 2 damage back to attackers per level.

passives.name: Veterans of Osgiliath
passives.text: His guards hold the line {amount} seconds longer.

passives.name: Stone of Minas Tirith
passives.text: +5 max health and +1 health regeneration per level.

passives.name: Faramir's Rangers
passives.text: Trained in Ithilien: +2 ranged damage and +1 Accuracy per level.

passives.name: Hold the Line
passives.text: Below a quarter health he hits 3 harder per level, and +8% fear resistance per level.

passives.name: Captain's Command
passives.text: Call the Guard brings {amount} more guards.

skills.name: Call the Guard
skills.text: Two Guards of the Citadel march to his side and fight for {seconds}s, {amount} damage a hit.

skills.name: Shield Wall!
skills.text: Shields locked: {amount}% less damage for {seconds}s, and the wall shoves back all around.

skills.name: Horn of Gondor
skills.text: The great horn sounds: foes around are stunned {stun}s and take {damage}, his guards fight 6s longer.

skills.name: Charge of Dol Amroth
skills.text: A Swan Knight rides through the foes ahead: {amount} damage and a stun to each one it tramples.

skills.name: Light the Beacons
skills.text: The beacons are lit! For {seconds}s his blows deal {amount}% more and set foes burning.

skills.name: The Eagles Are Coming
skills.text: A Great Eagle stoops on the nearest foe: {damage} damage around it and a {stun} stun.
